_comment: Battlefield spells (design doc: cost = spell level x 2 + 1). Fields: classes = who can cast (ids from classes.json); stat = ability whose modifier boosts the spell (int = arcane, wis = divine); type = damage | heal | buff; range/area in battle squares (area 1 = a 3x3 burst); Damage spells never miss: each target rolls a save (d20 + bonus vs DC 10 + spell level + caster's stat mod) — save = which ability resists ('dex' to dodge a burst, 'wis' to resist divine power); success means half damage. auto = true means no save at all (magic missile always strikes true). Buffs last for the rest of the battle: hit adds to attack rolls, dmg to damage. Edit freely and refresh! 'condition': {id, rounds} — inflicted on targets that FAIL their save (or on every target if the spell allows no save). type 'afflict' = no damage, just a condition: the target saves (vs the same DC) or suffers it.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: A dart of force that never misses

lesser_fireball.name: Lesser Fireball
lesser_fireball.description: A burst of flame — it does not spare your friends!
